notes.title: English version Rejected.
notes.content:
I'm sorry.
English version rejected.

Due to internal circumstances, we tried to release an English translation of the Japanese game at low cost, without incurring the costs of translating it into English, but it seems that we will not be able to officially release the English translation until the completion of the Sacred Sword RaveRanciel Plus Episode.

Alternatively, we will release the English translation once the Japanese version becomes a hit and we are at a financial level where we can request an English translation.

Currently, the Japanese-English translation is halfway done, but when we actually played the game, we found that important parts of the main story were not translated, and we decided that we could not release it to native English speakers.

Please wait a little longer for the English translation,
and we appreciate your patience.

Kurotsu Shirou

notes.content:
We have an announcement for players of The Tale of the Holy Sword Reyvrancil and The Tale of the Holy Sword Reyvrancil + (Plus) Episode.

The developer's PC environment has changed,
and the file and folder names for the Windows version of The Tale of the Holy Sword Reyvrancil and The Tale of the Holy Sword Reyvrancil + (Plus) Episode have changed,
and the folder released in the major update will be C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\My Games\rrs-win,
and the file and folder names have changed.
The save data is in the www folder in the rrs_win folder that you have been playing until now,
so if you want to continue playing the data you have been playing until now,
please copy the save data from the www folder in the old folder name rrs_win
and paste it into the save folder in the www folder in the rrs-win folder,
and play.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and thank you for your cooperation.

There has also been a change in the folder name for MacOS.
It has been changed to rrs_macOS/Game.app,
and the old game folder
was supposed to be rrs_mac_os_X,
but the file folder name has been changed to rrs_macOS.

If you would like to transfer your game data,
please transfer your game save data from the old game folder.

We apologize for the trouble, and we appreciate your cooperation.

notes.title: The HolySword RaveRanciel Story+(Plus)Episode3 release
notes.content:
The Holy Sword Rave Rancil Story & The Holy Sword Rave Rancil Story + (Plus) Episode Series 1, 2, 3
The Holy Sword Rave Rancil Story + (Plus) Episode 3 Release
The Holy Sword Rave Rancil Story + (Plus) Episodes 1, 2, and 3 have been released.
The Holy Sword Rave Rancil Story
The Holy Sword Rave Rancil Story + (Plus) Episode 1
The Holy Sword Rave Rancil Story + (Plus) Episodes 1 and 2
This is a notice of a new major update for everyone who has purchased it.

With this update, the Holy Sword Rave Rancil Story + (Plus) Episode 3 has been released.
In addition, for those who are playing the Holy Sword Rave Rancil Story for the first time or for those who are playing it for the second time or more,
we have added a magic spell that allows you to instantly escape from dungeons other than certain dungeons, and
a magic spell that allows you to fast travel to certain villages and castle towns.

In addition, we have fixed minor bugs, added keyboard configuration, added a function to change the gamepad settings, and added the names of the people who cooperated this time to the credits. Thank you.

Furthermore, the additional episodes which contain spoilers will be completed in the next update, The Tale of Holy Sword Reyvrancil + (Plus) Episode 4,
with additional episodes planned to be released up to The Tale of Holy Sword Reyvrancil + (Plus) Episode 5.
Through several updates, The Tale of Holy Sword Reyvrancil and The Tale of Holy Sword Reyvrancil + (Plus) Episodes 1, 2, and 3 have become a refined RPG that even the creators themselves are amazed at.

As for future plans,

we plan to adjust the battle balance in response to changes to the status of boss characters in The Tale of Holy Sword Reyvrancil.
Please look forward to the continued evolution of the The Tale of Holy Sword Reyvrancil series.

There will be no price change as a result of this major update.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Update and MacOS version release.
notes.content:
Today we have updated the Holy Sword RaveRanciel story and the Holy Sword RaveRanciel story + (plus) episodes.
In addition to lightening the operation, the UI has been updated to make it easier to operate with the game pad, keyboard and mouse than the mobile version.
We are adjusting the battle balance.

In addition, the release of the MacOS version has also been released.

The price goes up each time the additional episode is updated, so if you want to get a lower price, we recommend purchasing from this work.

As it is 820 yen (in Japanese yen) and $7.99 at the time of plus episode first episode addition, as it is scheduled to be added to the fifth episode, the price is finally thinking about 3000 yen and $25.00~$27.00.
If you purchased Plus Episode I episodes, you can purchase at the price currently displayed in the store, so if you are playing, please purchase early.

Thank you for your continued support for the Kurotsu Shirou Project and the Holy Sword RaveRanciel.
